natural_ceiling_judgment: Bracket 4 Optimized commander-dependent Cyberman theft, nonartifact death, villainous choice and face-down combat engine
protected_identity: Missy converts another nonartifact nontoken creature's graveyard death into tapped face-down artifact Cyberman under our control
End step each opponent chooses artifact-creature damage or own card draw plus chaos ensues
Cybermen Squadron creates temporary myriad artifact combat pressure; tokens exile end combat
Sacrifice/drain outlets monetize death without claiming Missy automatically recurs artifact Cybermen
Face-down morph/disguise/turn-up effects and Doctor Who villainous choice are meaningful identity packages

preferred_challenger.hypothesis: After old grave creatures are exiled, Living Death sacrifices all creatures; Missy triggers on other nonartifact nontoken creature deaths even if she dies simultaneously; stolen bodies return tapped Cybermen after Living Death resolves
preferred_challenger.strongest_counterargument: The spell is symmetric, destroys our previous Cybermen without Missy recycling them, returns opponents' prior graveyard threats, kills Missy and removes immediate end-step choices; Cybership retains protected native flying Cybermen-generation role

critical_rules_cases: Missy death trigger checks last battlefield nonartifact characteristics and actual graveyard object
Token death does not return token after cease-to-exist state-based action
Previously returned Cyberman artifacts do not self-loop when sacrificed
Living Death first exiles old creature cards from each graveyard, then sacrifices all creatures, then returns initially exiled old cards; Missy simultaneous death still triggers
Missy villainous choice is sequential for each opponent and choices can yield card draw, not guaranteed artifact damage
Cybership needs crew 4 and combat damage to player to generate two Cybermen from library
Cybermen Squadron gives myriad to nonlegendary artifact creatures; tokens arrive attacking and leave end of combat
Face-down casts are colorless and can cause Ugin's Mastery colorless-creature-cast trigger
Panoptic Projektor discounts face-down creature spell casting, not no-cast Missy return
Blasting Station requires tap and sacrifice to ping and untaps on creature ETB; Goblin Bombardment already provides free untapped targeted ping
Commander-zone movement and graveyard-exile replacement shut off Missy reanimation
Missy is six mana with UBR pips; Living Death costs five including BB
